steps.name: change-notes
steps.run: python3 scripts/delivery/change_notes.py check --base-ref {base} || python scripts/delivery/change_notes.py check --base-ref {base}

steps.name: guards
steps.run: python3 scripts/delivery/rust_ci.py run -- cargo test --locked --workspace guard_

steps.name: lint
steps.run: python3 scripts/delivery/rust_ci.py run -- cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

steps.name: xwin
steps.run: python3 scripts/delivery/rust_ci.py run -- cargo xwin check --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
steps.run_full: python3 scripts/delivery/rust_ci.py run -- cargo xwin check --locked --workspace --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
steps._note: D144: needs the one-time recorded Microsoft CRT/SDK licence acceptance; drop this step and use a Windows runner otherwise.

scope_map.note: A change that touches only these paths selects the Rust steps and no JS steps.
